P01.rationale: The page features a large, prominent portrait of Niklas Niemeyer that serves as the dominant human anchor for the layout.

P05.rationale: While there is an author box with a photo and name, it functions more as a sidebar element than a framed client portrait within a case study context.

P07.rationale: There are no press logos or review grids present; the page relies on text-based authority rather than social proof apparatuses.

P10.rationale: The layout uses oversized decorative typographic elements like 'AUSBLICK' and 'Ein kurzer' to create visual hierarchy.

P11.rationale: The page contains real data-visualizations with specific numbers (30%, 60%) inside the dark blue graphic block.

P12.rationale: The layout is dense and magazine-quality, filling the sheet with text columns and a substantial visual element without sparse gaps.

P13.rationale: An intentional background texture/atmosphere is present in the form of the dark blue graphic block that anchors the lower half of the page.

P14.rationale: The full-bleed photo is treated with a dark overlay to ensure text readability, though the contrast could be slightly higher for optimal legibility.

P16.rationale: No device or product mockup is shown on this page; it relies entirely on typography and photography.

N07.rationale: The imagery looks specific to a real business context rather than generic stock photos, showing a genuine person in a work setting.

N08.rationale: There is minimal dead whitespace; the layout is tightly packed with content and visual elements throughout the page.

N10.rationale: Text sits on top of the dark blue graphic block without a scrim, which creates some contrast issues for readability in that specific area.
